label: Мост
description: The masculine noun 'мост' (bridge) across its case ladder, with the stressed locative 'на мосту́', accusative-with-через, plural forms, and common spatial collocations.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 1. 'Мост' is nominative, the naming case for the subject of the sentence. 2. 'Старый' agrees in masculine singular. 3. This is the baseline dictionary form.

missions.phrase: Новый мост через реку очень красивый.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Adjective agreement. 1. 'Мост' is the nominative subject. 2. 'Новый' and 'красивый' both take masculine singular endings. 3. Shows two adjectives agreeing with one noun.

missions.phrase: С холма мы видим длинный мост.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 1. 'Мост' is accusative here, but inanimate masculine nouns keep the nominative form. 2. 'Видим' governs it as object of perception.
Strategic focus: Accusative with через. 1. 'Через' requires the accusative, so 'мост' stays in its base form. 2. The phrase means crossing from one side to the other. 3. Key motion collocation.
Strategic focus: Genitive with до. 1. 'До' governs the genitive, giving 'моста́' with end-stress. 2. It marks the endpoint of approach. 3. 'Недалеко' adds the sense of short distance.
Strategic focus: Genitive of location. 1. 'У' takes the genitive 'моста́', stressed on the ending. 2. It means near or by the bridge. 3. 'Река' anchors the scene.

missions.phrase: Каждое утро я иду к мосту.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 1. 'К' governs the dative 'мосту́' with end-stress. 2. It expresses movement toward the bridge. 3. Common directional pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative with по. 1. 'По' takes the dative 'мосту́', stressed on the ending. 2. It means movement along the surface of the bridge. 3. 'Машины' fills the scene.

missions.phrase: Под мостом всегда темно и сыро.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental of place. 1. 'Под' with the instrumental gives 'мосто́м', stressed on the ending. 2. It locates something beneath the bridge. 3. 'Темно' describes the space.
Strategic focus: Instrumental above. 1. 'Над' governs the instrumental 'мосто́м'. 2. It marks what lies above the bridge. 3. 'Небо' makes the picture concrete.

missions.phrase: Мы стоим на мосту и смотрим вниз.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Stressed locative -у́. 1. 'Мост' takes a special locative 'на мосту́' with stressed -у́, not the regular prepositional -е. 2. It means standing on the bridge. 3. Memorize this irregular form.
Strategic focus: Locative for meeting place. 1. 'На мосту́' again uses the stressed -у́ locative, unique to this noun class. 2. It names where the action happens. 3. Practical arrangement phrase.

missions.phrase: Я часто думаю о старом мосте.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of topic. 1. With 'о', the noun takes the regular prepositional 'мосте́', distinct from the locative 'на мосту́'. 2. It marks the subject of thought. 3. Contrast the -е/-у́ forms.
Strategic focus: Paucal after два. 1. 'Два' forces the genitive singular, not the plural. 2. 'Моста' is the genitive singular of мост. 3. The numerals 2, 3, 4 all take this genitive-singular form.

missions.phrase: В нашем городе есть красивые мосты.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural subject in a scene. 1. 'Мосты́' is nominative plural with end-stress. 2. 'В городе' sets the location. 3. Builds a simple existential statement.

missions.phrase: В этом городе очень много мостов.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 1. 'Много' requires the genitive plural 'мосто́в', stressed on the ending. 2. It counts an indefinite number. 3. Standard quantity construction.
Strategic focus: Adjective agreement in a scene. 1. 'Красивый' agrees with masculine singular nominative 'мост'. 2. 'Ночью' is an instrumental adverb of time. 3. Combines description with setting.
